definitions.gloss: tubers and root starches; the potato family of foods
definitions.explanation: The food category that groups starchy tubers and roots together, including じゃがいも (potato), さつまいも (sweet potato), さといも (taro), and やまいも (yam).

examples.japanese: {芋類|いもるい}は{炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}が{多|おお}い。
{芋類|いもるい}には{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}が{豊富|ほうふ}に{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: Tubers contain plenty of dietary fiber.

examples.japanese: {芋類|いもるい}は{種類|しゅるい}によって{調理|ちょうり}の{仕方|しかた}が{大|おお}きく{変|か}わる。
examples.english: How you cook tubers varies greatly depending on the type.

notes:
Formed from {芋|いも} (tuber, potato) + {類|るい} (category, kind). A collective term used in nutrition and cooking to group starchy roots.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芋類|いもるい}を{食|た}べる: to eat tubers
- {芋類|いもるい}{中心|ちゅうしん}の{食事|しょくじ}: a tuber-centered diet
- {根菜類|こんさいるい}と{芋類|いもるい}: root vegetables and tubers
